claims.claim: The command history shows the local `tailor` binary's help output (`--help`) or an error message being read before the maintenance command was run.
A local `tailor` maintenance command that needs no Tailor cloud credentials ran afterwards and succeeded, as shown by its output or the files it changed.
A Markdown note in the workspace names the command that was run and explains why it was chosen.
The command named in the note matches a successful command in the command history.
